name: European Pedunculate Oak Destructive Harvest Dataset
source: European Forestry Research Institute & Silva Fennica

publication_reference.citation: Zianis, D., et al. (2005). Biomass and stem volume equations for tree species in Europe. Silva Fennica Monographs, 4, 1-63.

collection_methodology: Destructive whole-tree felling. Component fractionation (stem wood, branches, bark, foliage) with oven drying at 105°C until stable dry mass.

dbh_cm.name: Diameter at Breast Height
dbh_cm.definition: Stem diameter measured perpendicularly at 1.30 m height above ground level.

height_m.name: Total Tree Height
height_m.definition: Vertical distance from stem base to the highest living apical bud.

crown_diameter_m.name: Crown Spread Diameter
crown_diameter_m.definition: Arithmetic mean of two orthogonal horizontal crown projection diameters.

age_years.name: Tree Age
age_years.definition: Dendrochronological ring count evaluated on cross-sectional stem disks at trunk base.

wood_density_g_cm3.name: Basic Wood Density
wood_density_g_cm3.definition: Oven-dry mass divided by green (water-saturated) volume of xylem tissue.

preprocessing_information.missing_values: Samples with missing DBH or total height removed from training set.
preprocessing_information.transformations: Natural log transformation applied for allometric power-law parameter estimation with Baskerville back-transformation correction factor.
preprocessing_information.validation_split: 70% Train, 15% Validation, 15% Test stratified by 10-cm DBH bins.
